description: Semantic-configuration-drift experiment for the AgentISA cache-key contract: after a deployment-wide template_version / decoding change, strictly namespaced cache keys must miss the pre-drift key (invalidation, fresh re-execution, and isolation-not-eviction on rollback) while regular legacy params-only keys keep hitting -- and thereby serve entries produced under the pre-drift configuration.  Hit/miss and stale/fresh serving are quantified per axis and arm.

scale.lookups_per_item: 4 (cold, warm, post-drift x2) + 1 rollback lookup for strict cohorts on the template_version/decoding axes

dependency.usage: strict arm attaches a shared CacheKeyNamespace to each CompositeInstruction and mutates it in place at the drift event; keys are produced by the production Instruction._get_cache_key -> build_cache_key path

provenance.determinism: pure in-process mock; no network, no sleeps, no live LLM; identical (seeds, items) reproduce identical measurements (timestamp and wall time excluded)

decoding_benign_reorder.decoding: key insertion order only; values identical

config.shared_namespace: one CacheKeyNamespace object shared by all strict-arm composites in a cohort and mutated in place at the drift event (the deployment's namespace bookkeeping)
config.measurement_protocol: each lookup is CompositeInstruction.execute(params); a lookup is a miss iff the wrapped leaf body actually ran; a served result is stale iff its embedded semantic config snapshot differs (canonically) from the deployment's current config

aggregation.per_seed: each cohort runs one seed; rates are computed from that cohort's raw counts
aggregation.across_seeds: mean = statistics.mean; stdev = statistics.stdev (sample, ddof=1; 0.0 when a single seed is run); min/max recorded alongside
aggregation.discipline: every aggregate number in this file is computed by examples/benchmarks/cache_namespace_experiment.py from the per-seed raw counts; none are hand-entered

not_covered: model_alias drift (the third namespace component; not part of this experiment's mandate)
shared-store cross-instruction key collisions (covered by unit tests in tests/core/isa/test_cache_namespacing.py)
TTL expiry and LRU eviction dynamics (ttl=3600s and max_size=1000 far exceed the 2 keys each per-item cache ever holds; drift dynamics are the subject here)
notes: regular-arm post-drift hits are the expected legacy behavior being quantified (keys not invalidated); their served entries embed the pre-drift semantic configuration, reported as stale_serve_rate
no live LLM is contacted: the leaf is an in-process mock embedding the current deployment config; all hit/miss decisions come from the real InstructionCache/CompositeInstruction code paths

metric_definitions.invalidation_rate: fraction of items whose FIRST post-drift lookup missed the pre-drift key (leaf re-executed under the new configuration)
metric_definitions.hit_rate: fraction of items whose first post-drift lookup was served from cache without re-execution
metric_definitions.fresh_serve_rate: fraction of first post-drift lookups whose served result embeds the deployment's CURRENT semantic configuration (canonical comparison)
metric_definitions.stale_serve_rate: fraction of first post-drift lookups served an entry produced under the PRE-drift configuration
metric_definitions.rollback_hit_rate: fraction of strict items that, after the namespace is reverted to baseline, hit the still-resident original entry (isolation, not eviction)
